title: Filter cheats by source and armed state
changes: Use machine-readable source-plan, declared-region and armed metadata for cheat filters instead of comparing translated labels; add explicit armed and not-armed choices while keeping generic content filters unchanged.
Explain that a plan candidate still needs runtime preflight and is not proof of device or gameplay compatibility.
validation: Frozen Windows GNU release build succeeded with 1942 source files and no source or overlay drift; 18 selector tests passed under Wine, including localized labels and refresh after armed-state changes.

Synthetic Wine/Xvfb GUI showed 3 plan candidates, 4 declared-region matches, 1 needing attention, and armed count 0→1→0 plus 4 not armed; the game state, frame and clock stayed unchanged, and the isolated session closed with original inputs and pins unchanged. The first immediate post-disarm screenshot preceded redraw; the later image confirms the cleared state.
limitations: This implements filter behavior only: values, named groups and presets remain open. Candidate status is a source-bound preflight hint, not execution or compatibility verification; native Windows and physical controller input were not tested.
